title: SIGSEGV with output handler in tv_copy

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
Neovim just crashed with a warning (which I do not have anymore) from inside an output handler with the following code:

```vim
        let data = map(copy(a:data), "substitute(v:val, '\\r$', '', '')")
```

This was using buffered output.
